text:
Ava Nguyen: Quick thread — sketching a 'signal harness' for the private preview cohort we want to kick off in Q3. Need crisp recruitment filters + feedback cadence + success criteria. High level: 8–10 customers, mixed infra (hosted/dedicated/private), 6-week engagement. Flags?
Luis Romero: Love 'signal harness' name :laughing: Quick Q on infra mix — prioritize private customers who can share perf traces?
Priya Shah: @Luis yes, want at least 3 VPC/private with telemetry access. We should add a slot for a 'latency/cost SLO' baseline capture.
Kelvin Park: For recruitment filters I propose: (1) ops contact, (2) 2 FTEs allocated, (3) use case aligns with high-QPS or regulated data. Shortlist sample size 25 -> convert ~8.
Ava Nguyen: Agree. Also want a lightweight rubric for quality signals: prompt set (5 canonical prompts), latency median/p95, token cost delta vs baseline, functional regressions (top5 failing prompts).
Priya Shah: We can collect structured feedback via 1) weekly 15m sync, 2) async Notion template, 3) an eval harness run at weeks 0/2/6. I'll draft template.
dp-coordinator-bot: Reminder: cohort size cap = 12. Auto-invite closes in 72h when shortlist created.
Luis Romero: Launch criteria idea: minimum 6 engaged customers at week2 (submitted >1 eval), no >30% drop in prompt coverage, performance regressions quantified and triaged.
Kelvin Park: For incentive, offer 3 months of Dedicated credit + engineering office hours. Need legal quick NDA flag for regulated customers.
Ava Nguyen: Action items: Priya to draft recruitment email + Notion template by EOD Tue. Kelvin to draft incentive/legal note. Luis to design eval harness (prompt set + metrics). I'll own shortlist + outreach.
Priya Shah: I'll add a simple CSV capture for telemetry consent; sample columns: customer, infra, contact, telemetry_access, allotted_FTE, expected_qps.
Ava Nguyen: SG, let's sync Fri 9am. If anyone can't make async update in thread. :thumbsup:
